name: p11_field_start_sleep_bed_cutscene
summary: Starts the player go-to-bed sequence (action state 0x4a), sets event flag 9, computes bed destination offsets via FUN_800ce2ec, and arms day-end fade globals.

name: p11_field_get_barn_or_coop_spawn_pos
summary: Selects map spawn preset 0..2 from active map ID *(DAT_800a0378+4) (0x54..0x5b) and writes DAT_801232bc/DAT_801232be (x, 0, z) into out_pos.

summary: Interpolates a 17-step jump arc between DAT_80128ce0 and DAT_80128cd0 via hm_clut_lerp_rgb_triple, updates player position (+0x100..+0x108) and DAT_800a03a4..a8, and clears DAT_8006c844 bit 0x400000 on completion.

name: p11_field_get_seed_season_index
summary: Returns signed 16-bit offset (item_id - 0x70) used to map tool/seed item IDs.

name: p11_field_is_item_seed_bag
summary: Returns true if item_id falls within the 6-item seed bag range 0x7d..0x82.

name: p11_field_snap_pos_to_valid_ground_y
summary: Iterates height offsets in table 0x801232c8 via FUN_8001e334 and hm_ovl11_update_camera_projection until a passable ground elevation is found, updating world_pos[1].

name: p11_field_init_winter_pond_sprite
summary: Resets DAT_80123154 to 0, then in winter (DAT_80070cf2 == 3) checks sprite asset 0x187 via FUN_800d688c, sets DAT_80123154 = 1, and initializes DAT_80128d00 via hm_sprite_init_0x0e_anim.

name: p11_field_step_demo_input_playback
summary: Advances attract-mode/demo input buffer DAT_8006c854 up to 0x738 frames when flags 0x8000/0x10000 in DAT_8006c844 are active, then sets DAT_800a0490 = 0x1a.

name: p11_field_update_farm_world_and_bgm
summary: Runs world tick updates for ground pickups, wild critters, crop growth, shipping/upgrades, and weather FX, then starts queued CD-XA stream 0x8007621e when ready.

name: p11_field_reset_all_animal_and_pickup_slots
summary: Clears chicken, barn livestock, critter, pickup, horse, dog, shipping markers, and breeding slot tables, spawns the initial horse entity (0x107), and resets animal counters.

name: p11_field_step_all_farm_entities
summary: Updates all active chickens (10 slots at 0x800742ec), barn livestock (20 slots at 0x800749f4), and ground pickups (6 slots at 0x80075bc4) when scene flag bit 3 is clear.

name: p11_field_pickup_world_entity_or_horse
summary: Handles picking up a carryable world entity (checking FUN_800d589c), locking it for player carry or dismounting/claiming a horse state via FUN_800e6eac and hm_ovl11_query_pasture_tile_grass.

name: p11_field_place_entity_and_project_ground
summary: Clears entity lock bit 0x20000, writes an unaligned 32-bit attribute/facing value at +0x2e, copies transform_pos to +0x38..+0x44, and queries ground height via hm_ovl11_update_camera_projection.

name: p11_field_drop_carried_entity_at_pos
summary: Places a carried chicken, cow/sheep, horse, or ground item back into the world via FUN_800cefcc, assigning basket/fish/truffle states or clearing invalid dropped items.

name: p11_field_is_entity_type_valid_in_zone
summary: Obtains current area mask from FUN_800d2e20 and scans the 17-entry table DAT_80123758 (stride 0x18) to check if entity_type is permitted in the active zone.

name: p11_field_clear_held_flag_if_not_carried
summary: Clears carried flag 0x20000 in entity_rec+0x34 if the player's carried item at DAT_80071a88+2 no longer matches *entity_rec.

name: p11_field_set_pending_animal_alert
summary: Stores pending animal alert category alert_kind into DAT_80128d68.

name: p11_field_spawn_dog_at_player_pos
summary: Writes dog position (DAT_80075b0c/10/14) and area state (DAT_80075b00/04) in g_anim_dog_state_80075ad4 and resets player emote/state via FUN_80107dd0(player_state+0xa8).

name: p11_field_clear_world_entity_slots
summary: Loops over the 6 world actor/prop slots at DAT_80075bc4 (stride 0xb0) and clears matching slots via FUN_800d3200, respecting bit 0x20000 and wild-dog flag 0x1000000 in DAT_80070d30.

name: p11_field_spawn_seasonal_map_items
summary: Calls FUN_800cf748 and FUN_800cf848, then in sunny weather iterates 17 seasonal forage entries in 0x80123758 matched by FUN_800d2e20 and spawns them via hm_ovl11_spawn_harvest_pickup.

name: p11_field_spawn_wild_critters_stub
summary: No-op stub function (optimized out / unreachable critter spawn block) returning immediately in wave 8 of farm_crops_field.

name: p11_field_spawn_map_forage_pickups
summary: Iterates up to 6 entries in table 0x80123940 and spawns wild/forageable ground items (including truffle 0x17a gated on flag 0x80076210) with randomized facing via hm_ovl11_spawn_harvest_pickup.

name: p11_field_roll_spawn_bug_or_forage_drop
summary: During sunny non-winter weather, rolls a 1-in-50 chance to spawn a field drop (0x156 or 0x157) at the disturbed tile coordinates via hm_ovl11_spawn_harvest_pickup.

name: p11_field_roll_wild_dog_spawn_flag
summary: Checks if outdoor livestock or chickens exist via FUN_800d3230(0/1), weather DAT_8007ad00 is clear (0), season DAT_80070cf2 is not winter (3), and rolls 1-in-10 chance via hm_prng_next to set wild dog bit 0x800000 in DAT_80070d30.

name: p11_field_test_animal_health_bitmask
summary: Checks sick bit 0x100 and flag bit 0x80000 in animal_rec+0x34 against query bits 1 and 2 of health_mask, returning 1 on match.

name: p11_field_query_any_animal_flag_match
summary: Tests cows/sheep in DAT_800749f4 (bits 1/2) and chickens in DAT_800742ec (bit 4) via FUN_800cfad0(..., target_area), returning 1 on the first matching animal.

name: p11_field_reset_animals_for_festival_day
summary: Removes event-flagged livestock and chickens from the active field via FUN_800df0f8 and FUN_800e2904, dropping any carried chicken first and incrementing weather/state counters.

name: p11_field_spawn_shipping_bin_markers
summary: Spawns up to three actor entities (type 0x109, state 0x30) at coordinates from table 0x801239d0 via FUN_800e1f9c.

name: p11_field_render_animal_actor_sprite
summary: Projects an animal actor's position via hm_ovl11_project_npc_bubble_pos, draws its emote/carried icons and main sprite, submits its shadow via FUN_800d037c, and advances its animation frame.

name: p11_field_render_npc_or_livestock_mesh
summary: Projects an NPC or large livestock actor, submits its 3D/billboard sprite quad via FUN_80015dd4 and emotion icon via FUN_80107e2c, projects ground shadow when flag 0x1000000 is set, and steps animation.

name: p11_field_submit_entity_shadow_if_enabled
summary: Calls FUN_800c9e90 to draw a shadow quad at screen coordinates when bit 12 (0x1000) of entity_flags is clear, passing bit 31 as the shadow size selector.

name: p11_field_integrate_vec3_velocity
summary: Adds 3D vector vel_vec to pos_vec and zeroes vel_vec when keep_velocity == 0.

name: p11_field_show_high_affection_heart_bubble
summary: When animal affection at animal_rec+0x16 is >= 10, displays heart emote (0x25, 0x2d) on animal_rec+0xa8 via FUN_80107de0.

name: p11_field_compare_axis_sign
summary: Returns 0 if cur_coord == target_coord, 1 if cur_coord < target_coord, or 2 if cur_coord >= target_coord.

name: p11_field_get_target_octant_direction
summary: Compares X (+0x38 vs +0x58) and Z (+0x40 vs +0x60) signs via FUN_800d0600 and indexes into the 3x3 direction lookup table DAT_80123a00.

name: p11_field_face_entity_toward_target
summary: Compares |dx| vs |dz| between current pos (+0x38, +0x3c) and target (+0x58, +0x5c), queries octant via FUN_800d062c, and writes the best cardinal direction (0..3) into entity_rec+0x22.

name: p11_field_place_animal_in_outdoor_zone
summary: Places an outdoor animal record at its pasture/yard slot by dispatching to FUN_800d29b0 for barn livestock (is_barn == 1) or FUN_800d2a88(animal_rec, slot_idx) for coop poultry.

name: p11_field_sync_outdoor_animals_from_tables
summary: Synchronizes outdoor animal placement via FUN_800d075c across the 20 barn livestock entries in DAT_800749f4 (state 5) or 10 chicken coop entries in DAT_800742ec (state 4), plus the 2 special slots referenced by DAT_80076200/DAT_80076202.

name: p11_field_alloc_pregnant_animal_slot
summary: Scans pregnancy tracking slots DAT_80076200 (indices 0..1 for cows gated by DAT_80070d08, or indices 2..3 for sheep gated by DAT_80070d0a) and returns the first free (-1) pair.

name: p11_field_deliver_newborn_animals
summary: Processes completed pregnancy/incubation slots in 0x80076200, waking newborn cows/sheep via FUN_800de924/FUN_800e04fc or respawning hatched chicks at incubator coordinates.

name: p11_field_check_breeding_slot_status
summary: Returns 2 if barn/coop breeding slot slot_idx is locked by upgrade flags DAT_80070d08/DAT_80070d0a, else returns 1 if DAT_80076200[slot_idx*2] is occupied.

name: p11_field_find_free_barn_animal_slot
summary: Scans up to 10 (or 20 if DAT_80070d08 != 0) records in DAT_800749f4 (stride 0xb8) for an empty un-reserved slot (*rec == 0 and bit 0x2000000 clear).

name: p11_field_find_free_coop_chicken_slot
summary: Scans up to 5 (or 10 if DAT_80070d0a != 0) records in DAT_800742ec (stride 0xb4) for an empty un-reserved slot (*rec == 0 and bit 0x2000000 clear).

name: p11_field_get_barn_animal_slot_index
summary: Finds index 0..19 of animal_rec inside DAT_800749f4 (stride 0xb8), or returns -1 if not found.

name: p11_field_set_breeding_pair_entry
summary: Stores animal_idx and days_left into a 2-short breeding/incubator slot entry.

name: p11_field_clear_breeding_pair_entry
summary: Resets both halfwords of a breeding/incubator pair entry to 0xffff.

name: p11_field_show_animal_status_dialogue
summary: Formats animal name (+4) and remaining days/hearts (+0xb2) into DAT_80128d70 via hm_text_fetch_script_entry and opens animal status dialogue (0x6bd..0x6c4) via hm_dialogue_set_window_state.

name: p11_field_mark_animal_daily_checked
summary: Sets daily interaction byte at slot_idx in DAT_800712f8 (barn) or DAT_8007130e (coop) to 1.

name: p11_field_is_animal_daily_checked
summary: Returns 1 if daily check byte slot_idx is non-zero in DAT_800712f8 (is_barn == 1) or DAT_8007130e (coop), else 0.

name: p11_field_assign_pregnant_or_isolated_slot
summary: Checks slot availability via FUN_800d0bc8, allocates free barn animal via FUN_800d0cd8, sets bit 0x2000000, records slot ID in DAT_80076200/DAT_80076202 via FUN_800e2934, and returns 0 or error message ID.

name: p11_field_return_pasture_animals_inside
summary: Checks whether horse, dog, 20 barn livestock, and 10 coop chickens are parked on outdoor return/coop tiles via FUN_800be208 and teleports them back inside the barn, coop, or house yard.

name: p11_field_set_selected_animal_slot
summary: Stores selected animal slot index slot_idx into DAT_8007621e.

name: p11_field_step_entity_path_movement
summary: Steps animal/pickup movement: evaluates water probe FUN_800d1e1c, selects cardinal heading via FUN_800d196c from forward/left/right probes (FUN_800be208, FUN_800d2db8, FUN_800d24fc), seeks target or jumps via FUN_800d2594, and runs zone transitions via FUN_800d2b40.

name: p11_field_set_seek_arrival_radius
summary: Sets entity seek arrival distance threshold DAT_80123754 to radius.

name: p11_field_choose_entity_move_dir
summary: Computes a farm animal or pickup actor's next cardinal direction from turn_mode (0..7) and tests wall/actor collisions via FUN_800d2db8, FUN_800be208, and FUN_800d24fc.

name: p11_field_pick_weighted_wander_direction
summary: Rolls 0..100 via hm_prng_next against 4-entry directional probability table DAT_801232d4 indexed by (entity_kind, cur_dir, probe_state), returning direction 0..3 or 4 if none matched.

name: p11_field_compare_seek_axis
summary: Compares cur_coord against target_coord for target seeking, returning 0 if equal, 1 if less, or 2 otherwise.

name: p11_field_compute_seek_move_mask
summary: Computes delta to target (+0x58, +0x60 vs +0x38, +0x40), clears arrive bit 0x2000 in +0x34 when within DAT_80123754 tolerance, or returns movement bitmask from DAT_80123a18 using FUN_800d1cd0.

name: p11_field_check_actor_water_or_zone
summary: Probes zone flag 0x10 at the actor's current position via FUN_800be208 and toggles status bit 0x200000 on +0x34 accordingly.

name: p11_field_tick_wild_critter_slots
summary: Updates the 3 wild critter/rabbit/butterfly slots at 0x80075fe4 by calling FUN_800e276c, FUN_800e1f70, FUN_800e1ec0, and toggling visibility timer at +0xa8.

name: p11_field_tick_all_ground_pickups
summary: Updates all 6 ground pickup slots at 0x80075bc4 via FUN_800d3048, integrates motion via FUN_800d2f1c, and updates sprite frames via FUN_800d2e6c while uncarried.

name: p11_field_probe_entity_collision
summary: Extracts packed 3-byte entity collision bounds from entity_rec+0x2e..0x31, tests world collision via FUN_800bdf98, and sets bit 0x1000000 in entity_rec+0x34 when hit returns 2 and set_hit_flag == 1.

name: p11_field_step_entity_jump_arc
summary: Drives a 400-unit vertical jump arc over Y (+0x3c) and Y velocity (+0x4c) in entity_rec using jump bit 0x400000 on +0x34, returning 1 while airborne and 0 on landing.

name: p11_field_step_pet_follow_and_timer
summary: While *timer_ptr < 300, updates entity target to player coordinates (DAT_80071b00/04/08/0c) via hm_ovl11_modify_gold_or_counters when lock bit 0x2000 is set, and increments *timer_ptr when state matches active_state.

name: p11_field_flush_pending_animal_interaction
summary: When DAT_80128d68 != -1 and FUN_800cbdfc returns non-zero, dispatches pending animal state update via FUN_800d2764((int)DAT_80128d68) and resets DAT_80128d68 to -1.

name: p11_field_update_animal_fence_alerts
summary: Evaluates outdoor pasture/pet status for area_kind (0: horse + 20 barn livestock in DAT_800749f4, 1: horse via hm_ovl11_query_pasture_tile_grass, 2: dog DAT_80075ad4 via FUN_8010b57c) and clears alert counters DAT_80128d60/62/64 when calm.

name: p11_field_dispatch_item_use_effect
summary: Dispatches item_id in range 0xa1..0x165 via jump table PTR_LAB_800b8840 to execute item consumption/spawn behavior.

name: p11_field_place_barn_animal_in_pasture
summary: Computes barn stall/pasture position from DAT_80123a2c/30/34 for slot_idx (-1, -2, or 0..19 in rows of 5), writes +0x38..+0x40, sets facing 1 or 3, and sets zone 5.

name: p11_field_place_coop_chicken_in_yard
summary: Computes yard grid coordinates from DAT_80123a8c/90/94 using slot_idx/5 and slot_idx%5 (400-unit spacing), writes position (+0x38..+0x40), rolls random facing via hm_prng_next(4), and sets zone 4.

name: p11_field_apply_entity_zone_transition
summary: Tests zone transition flags 0x4000000..0x20000000 on entity_rec+0x34, resolves exit coordinates across farm/barn/greenhouse/coop via FUN_800be118, updates entity position, and clears velocity/lock flag 0x2000.

name: p11_field_init_spawned_animal_flags
summary: Sets bit 0x1000 for wild/forage critters (0x113..0x157) or bit 0x80000000 for cows (0x162, 0x163) in entity status flags at animal_rec+0x34.

name: p11_field_is_tile_or_wall_blocked
summary: Checks raycast obstruction via hm_ovl11_raycast_ground_height when 0x80128d6c equals 1 and otherwise tests ground collision mask 0xc000 via hm_ovl11_update_camera_projection.

name: p11_field_get_season_bitmask
summary: Converts current season DAT_80070cf2 (0..3) into a 1-hot bitmask (1, 2, 4, or 8).

name: p11_field_update_pickup_sprite_anim
summary: Looks up sprite/palette indices via FUN_800d3424 for a ground pickup slot, applies any changed sprite state, advances animation via hm_ovl11_spawn_soil_splash_fx, and marks visibility.

name: p11_field_sync_entity_velocity_to_pos
summary: Adds velocity (+0x48) into position (+0x38) with zero Y override via FUN_800d03b4(entity_rec+0x38, entity_rec+0x48, 0).

name: p11_field_spawn_ground_pickup_item
summary: Finds a free slot among the 6 ground pickup slots at 0x80075bc4, initializes it via FUN_800d3390, stamps calendar day/time from 0x80070cf0..0x80070cf4, and configures fish/truffle variants.

name: p11_field_tick_ground_pickup_slot
summary: Updates an active ground pickup slot by running FUN_800d3574, dispatching its state handler from PTR_FUN_800b8ec0, and expiring non-locked items after 300 ticks.

name: p11_field_transition_world_entity_ai
summary: Runs AI state entry callback from DAT_800b8e6c[next_state], and if PTR_FUN_800b8ec0[next_state] is non-null and entry succeeds, commits next_state (+0x26), resets timers (+0x28..+0x2c), and zeroes velocity via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags.

name: p11_field_set_tool_hit_animal_pair
summary: Records hit animal kind and slot index in DAT_80128d78 and DAT_80128d7a.

name: p11_field_zero_world_entity_slot
summary: Zeroes all 0xb0 bytes of a world entity/critter record using memset and clears its leading ID bytes.

name: p11_field_find_outdoor_animal_slot
summary: Thin wrapper invoking FUN_800d3d60(building_kind) to locate a random active outdoor animal slot index.

name: p11_field_apply_wild_dog_scare_penalty
summary: For wild dog entity (0x15b), when morning outside (FUN_800c0824 == 1, DAT_80070d30 bit 0x1000000 set, DAT_80070cf8 >= 7), picks a random outdoor animal via FUN_800d3d60 and subtracts 10 affection from DAT_80074a0a/DAT_80074302.

name: p11_field_alloc_and_init_pickup_slot
summary: Zeroes an empty 0xb0-byte ground pickup slot, assigns item_id, initializes its sprite state via FUN_800d3404, and clears its sub-state at +0x54 via FUN_80107dd0.

name: p11_field_set_pickup_item_id
summary: Stores item_id into the ground pickup slot header and invokes FUN_800d3574 to initialize its sprite and runtime state.

name: p11_field_get_critter_spawn_zone_rect
summary: Reads packed u16 pair from DAT_80123aac/DAT_80123aae indexed by (group_idx, entry_idx) into out_val_a and optional out_val_b, returning 0.

name: p11_crop_select_world_entity_ai_state
summary: Dispatches initial AI state by entity type *entity_rec (0x108..0x17b) via FUN_800d3c04/c54/ca4/ce8/d2c or SystemError('E', 100) on unknown type, then commits state via FUN_800d3104.

name: p11_crop_init_world_entity_or_weather_sprite
summary: Selects seasonal field foliage/prop sprite table offsets in DAT_80098bf8, DAT_8009a3f8, or DAT_8009cbf8 by entity_rec[0] (0x108..0x17b) and DAT_80070cf2, loads weather sprites 0x28..0x2c via hm_ovl11_load_weather_sprites, or initializes 0x0e anim via hm_sprite_init_0x0e_anim.

name: p11_field_get_entity_walk_speed
summary: Returns base movement speed by entity ID *entity_rec: 0x18 for wild dog (0x15b), 6 for adult/calf cow (0x162/0x165), or 0xc for all other critters/animals.

name: p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_a
summary: Rolls 1-in-3 (or 1-in-8 when bit 0x2000 is set) via hm_prng_next to pick AI state 8, 9, or 1.

name: p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_b
summary: Rolls 1-in-3 (or 1-in-8 when bit 0x2000 is set) via hm_prng_next to pick AI state 0xb, 0xc, or 1.

name: p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_c
summary: Rolls 1-in-2 (or 1-in-7 when bit 0x2000 is set) via hm_prng_next to pick AI state 10 or 1.

name: p11_crop_roll_npc_or_critter_state_d
summary: Rolls 1-in-2 (or 1-in-7 when bit 0x2000 is set) via hm_prng_next to pick AI state 0xd or 1.

name: p11_field_get_wild_dog_initial_ai_state
summary: Returns wild dog AI state 0x13 if hour DAT_80070cf8 < 7 or timer entity_rec+0xac <= 0, else active chase state 0x14.

name: p11_field_pick_random_grazing_animal
summary: Collects active outdoor animals (zone == 1, flags & 0x20400 == 0) from barn DAT_800749f4 (is_coop == 0, 20 slots) or coop DAT_800742ec (10 slots) and returns a random index via hm_prng_next or -1.

name: p11_field_find_nearby_outdoor_animal
summary: Searches barn livestock DAT_800749f4 (types 0/1) and chicken coop DAT_800742ec (type 2) matching zone_id within search_radius of (origin_x, origin_z), returning the slot index or -1.

name: p11_spr_show_animal_or_prop_inspect_msg
summary: Selects dialogue ID (0x261..0x277) from entity type *entity_rec and sub-state entity_rec[0x18] (tracking first-time event flags 0x9e/0x9f and DAT_80076210), opens message via hm_dialogue_set_window_state, and returns -1.

name: p11_spr_step_anim_tbl_80123bcc
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table DAT_80123bcc via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, sets bit 0x800 during playback, and sets +0x2c = 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_entity_walk_speed
summary: Looks up move speed via FUN_800d3bb0, steps entity movement via FUN_800d12b8 (mask 0x9010 for 0x15b, else 0x8031), sets moving flag at entity_rec[0x12], and clears bit 0x800 of entity_rec+0x34.

name: p11_spr_step_anim_tbl_80123bd4
summary: Steps action script table DAT_80123bd4 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack with random initial timer hm_prng_next(0x3c), dispatches sub-phase via PTR_LAB_800b9484 jump table, and despawns via FUN_800d3200 when finished.

name: p11_spr_step_anim_tbl_80123bec
summary: Steps action script table DAT_80123bec via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, applies speed-12 facing velocity on phase 2 via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags, and despawns entity via FUN_800d3200 when done.

name: p11_spr_step_anim_tbl_80123bf8
summary: Steps action script table DAT_80123bf8 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, sets active bit 0x800 on start, and despawns entity via FUN_800d3200 when phase reaches -1.

name: p11_spr_step_anim_tbl_80123c08
summary: Drives world entity action animation from script table DAT_80123c08 via hm_ovl11_add_item_to_rucksack, toggling active bit 0x800 and resetting +0x2c to 300 on completion (-1).

name: p11_spr_step_anim_tbl_80123c14

summary: Reads descriptor flags in DAT_8006c858[item_id*0x28] and returns 0 if bit 0x4000 is set, 1 if bits 0x8100 are set, or 2 otherwise.

name: p11_spr_get_item_equip_slot_type
summary: Extracts equipment category 0..3 from bits 0x10000000..0x40000000 of DAT_8006c858[item_id*0x28 + 0x18].

name: p11_spr_is_item_edible_or_holdable
summary: Returns true when the sign bit (0x80000000) is set on item descriptor dword DAT_8006c858[item_id*0x28 + 0x18].

name: p11_spr_has_item_flag_0x8100
summary: Returns true when mask 0x8100 is non-zero in the leading flags word of DAT_8006c858[item_id*0x28].

summary: Reads descriptor entry DAT_8006c858[item_slot[0]*0x28], chooses parameter byte from puVar4[0x10] or item_slot[1] (if bit 0x800 set), and invokes callback pointer at +0x1c or returns -1.

name: p11_spr_find_tool_pattern_cell_offset
summary: Looks up a 13x13 tool area pattern in DAT_8006c858/DAT_8006c85c, rotates it by facing_dir via FUN_800d6488, and outputs relative tile offsets (out_dx, out_dz) for step_index + 1.

name: p11_spr_get_crop_max_growth_stage
summary: Looks up crop growth index at DAT_8006c858[crop_item_id*0x28 + 3] and returns mature stage count from DAT_8006c864[idx*0x10 + 2], or -1 if invalid.

name: p11_spr_get_crop_regrow_stage
summary: Looks up crop growth index at DAT_8006c858[crop_item_id*0x28 + 3] and returns post-harvest regrow stage at DAT_8006c864[idx*0x10 + 4], or -1 if non-regrowing.

name: p11_spr_get_crop_harvest_item_id
summary: Looks up crop growth index at DAT_8006c858[crop_item_id*0x28 + 3] and returns harvested produce item ID at DAT_8006c864[idx*0x10 + 0xe], or 0.

name: p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x8000

name: p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x2000

name: p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x4000
summary: Looks up sub-entry index at DAT_8006c858[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] into DAT_8006c860 and tests flag bit 0x4000.

name: p11_spr_get_sub_entry_u16_0_if_flagged

name: p11_spr_get_sub_entry_u16_2_if_flagged
summary: Reads 8-byte entry in DAT_8006c860 referenced by DAT_8006c858[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] and returns halfword +2 when mask 0xe000 is non-zero, or -1.

name: p11_spr_has_recipe_ingredient_bit_0x800
summary: Looks up sub-entry index at DAT_8006c858[item_id*0x28 + 4 + slot_idx*2] into DAT_8006c860 and tests flag bit 0x800.

summary: Returns shipping price at DAT_8006c858[(item_id&0xffff)*0x28 + 0x12], adding +10 bonus for item 0x97 (Apple/Honey event bit 0x400000 in DAT_80070d30).

name: p11_spr_is_item_shippable_flag
summary: Checks descriptor flags word (*desc & 0x8100 == 0x8000) and sub-byte != 1 in DAT_8006c858 for item_id.

name: p11_spr_get_recipe_dish_sub_id
summary: Returns item_slot[1] when item_slot[0] == 0xa4 (cooked/custom dish variant), otherwise 0.

name: p11_spr_get_npc_gift_reaction
summary: Decodes 3-bit NPC gift preference tier from packed table DAT_8006c86c indexed by descriptor gift group DAT_8006c858[item_id*0x28 + 0xe] and npc_id, adjusting tiers <5 when bits 0x180 are set.

name: p11_spr_get_crop_base_seed_id
summary: Looks up crop growth index at DAT_8006c858[crop_item_id*0x28 + 3] and returns first u16 in DAT_8006c864[idx*0x10], or -1 if invalid.

name: p11_spr_apply_stamina_fatigue_happiness
summary: Clamps and applies deltas to player stamina DAT_80071a12, fatigue DAT_80071a16 (0..100, capped at 99 at 6:00 when DAT_80070cf8 == 6), and DAT_80071a58, returning 1.

name: p11_spr_query_villager_heart_to_out
summary: Reads villager affection/heart level via hm_ovl11_get_villager_heart_level(npc_id, sub_idx), writes it to *out_hearts if non-null, and returns 1.

name: p11_spr_rotate_13x13_tool_pattern
summary: Copies or rotates a 13x13 byte pattern grid from src_grid into out_grid according to facing_dir (0, 1, 2, or 3).

name: p11_spr_reset_vram_pack_tables

summary: Finds the first unused slot row 0..7 in DAT_800a04b8 + bank_idx*0x10e where *entry != row*8 or entry[0xc] >= 0x3f0.

summary: Looks up area pack index *(DAT_800a0378+10), scans PTR_DAT_80126254/PTR_DAT_80125528 for prop_id, and returns &DAT_800957f8 + offset or NULL.

name: p11_spr_upload_pack_frames_to_vram
summary: Uploads pair_count texture and 16x1 CLUT RECT slices from pack_desc frame table into VRAM at (tex_x, tex_y) and (clut_x, clut_y) via MoveImage.

name: p11_spr_submit_pack_sprt_primitive
summary: Builds a SPRT + DR_MODE primitive pair from DAT_800a04b8[bank_idx, slot_idx], links both into ot_head via AddPrim, and returns advanced prim_buf + 0x20.

summary: Clears all three 16-bit fields of a 6-byte inventory item slot to zero.

name: p11_spr_set_item_slot_6b
summary: Populates a 6-byte item slot with item_id, sub_val, and count_val.

name: p11_spr_copy_item_slot_6b
summary: Copies three consecutive halfwords (6 bytes) from src_slot into dst_slot.

name: p11_spr_classify_held_item_action
summary: Classifies held item ID *item_slot using DAT_8006c858 descriptor bits (0x400 -> 4, 0x1800 -> 3, 0x40 -> 1, 0x100 -> 0) and special item IDs (0x3a..0x65 -> 5, default -> 2).

name: p11_spr_get_special_item_stamina_heal
summary: Returns stamina/recovery bonus for special forage/herb/medicine item IDs (0x5c, 0x60, 0x67, 0x97, 0x9c, 0x9e, 0xf7..0xf9, 0x185), or 0.

summary: Returns 1 if item_id is livestock fodder, lumber, or golden lumber (0x122..0x124, 0xe8, or 0x125), else 0.

name: p11_spr_is_item_pet_feed
summary: Returns 1 if item_id is dog/pet feed (0x8b..0x8d or 0xe3), else 0.

name: p11_spr_is_item_chicken_feed
summary: Returns 1 if item_id is chicken feed (0x91..0x93 or 0xe7), else 0.

summary: Iterates all 45x25 tiles in DAT_80071dfc, maps soil state (0x167..0x16b) or grass tile 0x36 connectivity mask to mesh variant ID, and updates tile visuals via FUN_800d759c.

summary: Scans the 45x25 outdoor farm field grid in world coordinates (-0x1068..+X, 0x5dc..-Z, step 400), probing collision flags via FUN_800bdb88 and caching matching cell pointers in 0x8009e5f8.

name: p11_spr_reset_greenhouse_field_grid
summary: Initializes all 7x7 tiles of DAT_80074124 (greenhouse grid) to empty soil 0x167 with zero growth/water bytes.

name: p11_spr_is_tile_blocked_or_oob
summary: Checks tile bounds (tile_x, tile_z) against DAT_80123e04/DAT_80123e06 and tests tile collision bit 8 in DAT_8009e5f8 when require_tillable != 0; returns 1 if blocked.

summary: Converts outdoor field (is_greenhouse == 0) or greenhouse 7x7 grid indices (tile_x, tile_z) at 400-unit spacing into world XZ coordinates in out_pos.

name: p11_spr_water_field_or_greenhouse_tile

name: p11_spr_harvest_crop_from_tile
summary: Validates harvestable mature crop on tile_ptr via FUN_800d5868/89c/c3c, advances regrowing crops via FUN_800d5c90 or resets tile to base soil, and maps flower IDs 0x3a..0x40 to 0x13a..0x13d by season DAT_80070cf2.

summary: Checks cuttable field contents via FUN_800d5d38, harvests fodder grass (0x36 -> FUN_800f397c) or clears weeds/dead crops via FUN_800dac08 and FUN_800dacd4, and rolls forage drop via FUN_800cf95c.

name: p11_spr_harvest_or_cut_field_tile

name: p11_spr_mark_all_field_tiles_dirty
summary: Iterates all 45x25 tiles in DAT_80071dfc (row stride 0xb4, tile stride 8) and sets bit 0x10 (rain/watered) or 0x20 (clear) on every tile via FUN_800da454.

name: p11_spr_reset_all_field_tile_flags
summary: Sweeps all 45x25 tiles in DAT_80071dfc and clears render/growth/water state flags via FUN_800da49c(..., 0x10), FUN_800da518(..., 8), and FUN_800da454(..., 0x10).

name: p11_spr_compute_visible_field_tile_bounds
summary: Projects a +/-0xe10 window around camera/spawn anchor (DAT_800a03a4, DAT_800a03a8) into clamped [0..0x2d] x [0..0x19] field tile bounds.

name: p11_spr_render_outdoor_field_crops

name: p11_spr_map_spring_crop_tile_sprite
summary: Maps Spring crop/flower/forage IDs (0x22..0x34, 0x3a..0x64, 0x16d..0x175) and growth_stage to sprite index, flags, and vertical offset via FUN_800d9efc.

name: p11_spr_map_summer_crop_tile_sprite
summary: Maps Summer crop/flower/forage IDs (0x22..0x35, 0x3a..0x40, 0x16d..0x175) and growth_stage to sprite index, flags, and vertical offset via FUN_800d9efc.

name: p11_spr_map_fall_crop_tile_sprite
summary: Maps Fall crop/flower/forage IDs (0x27..0x35, 0x3a..0x40, 0x16d..0x179) and growth_stage to sprite index, flags, and vertical offset via FUN_800d9efc.

name: p11_spr_emit_crop_sprite_if_grown
summary: If growth_stage != 0, writes flags_val and sprite_id into out_flags and out_sprite_id and returns 1, else returns 0.

name: p11_spr_render_greenhouse_crops
summary: Iterates over the 7x7 greenhouse grid DAT_80074124, projects each tile via hm_ovl11_project_npc_bubble_pos, maps crop IDs (0x22..0x3f, 0x175..0x179) and growth byte DAT_80074128 via FUN_800d9efc, and submits quads to DAT_8005e3c0 via hm_sprite_submit_0x0e_quad.

name: p11_spr_clear_field_tile_to_soil
summary: Resets a field or greenhouse 8-byte tile record to empty base soil 0x167 with zero stage/water flags.

name: p11_spr_try_spawn_bamboo_or_flower_tile
summary: Checks season DAT_80070cf2 (Spring 1/128, Summer 1/64, Fall 1/128) and if tile_ptr[0] is empty soil (0x167..0x169), rolls hm_prng_next to spawn forage item 0x40 on the tile.

name: p11_spr_try_wilt_blue_magic_flower
summary: If tile_ptr[0] is flower 0x3f and chance_denom != 0, rolls hm_prng_next(chance_denom & 0xffff) and converts it to rare variant 0x175 on 0.

name: p11_spr_try_wither_crop_tile_by_chance
summary: If tile_ptr[0] is an active non-grass crop via hm_ovl11_is_entity_slot_active and hm_prng_next(chance_denom) == 0, clears the crop back to tilled tile 0x168.

name: p11_spr_try_wither_grown_grass_tile
summary: If tile_ptr[0] is grown grass (0x36 with non-zero stage) and hm_prng_next(chance_denom) == 0, regresses its stage via FUN_800d5c90(0x36) and sets bit 0x8000 on tile_ptr[3].

name: p11_spr_init_pack_sprite_anims
summary: Reads sprite frame count (clamped to 0x2c) from PTR_DAT_80125528[pack_idx] and initializes consecutive 0x30-byte slots in DAT_80070400 from DAT_800957f8 offsets via hm_sprite_init_0x0e_anim.

name: p11_spr_update_grass_autotile_neighborhood
summary: Evaluates 3x3 grass (0x36) bitmasks across the 9 neighboring tiles around (tile_x, tile_z) using DAT_80123e14 and hm_ovl11_set_actor_facing_vec, computes autotile variants 0..7, and updates meshes via PTR_FUN_80123dfc.

name: p11_spr_spawn_grid_tile_effect
summary: Converts outdoor field (is_greenhouse == 0) or greenhouse (7x7) tile coordinates (grid_x, grid_z) into world space and spawns effect_id via FUN_8012135c.

name: p11_spr_cut_single_grass_tile
summary: Cuts grown grass tile 0x36 at (tile_x, tile_z) by resetting growth byte via FUN_800d5c90(0x36), setting bit 0x8000 on tile[3], and refreshing the tile mesh via PTR_FUN_80123dfc.

name: p11_spr_count_or_find_matching_tiles
summary: Scans DAT_80071dfc (45x25) or greenhouse DAT_80074124 (7x7) from a random start via hm_prng_next matching crop ID, soil ID, and stage byte per wildcard mask match_flags (bits 0..2), returning first or total count (bit 3).

name: p11_spr_dry_watered_field_tile
summary: Reverts watered soil states (0x169 -> 0x168, 0x16b -> 0x16a) overnight on an 8-byte field tile record.

name: p11_spr_init_default_camera_bounds
summary: Resets player/camera XZ clamp bounds DAT_80128de8..DAT_80128df4 to the default outdoor farm perimeter.

name: p11_spr_set_camera_clamp_bounds
summary: Copies min_vec[0..2] and max_vec[0..2] into world camera/entity boundary globals DAT_80128de8..DAT_80128df4.

name: p11_spr_clamp_pos_to_camera_bounds
summary: Clamps pos_vec[0] (X) and pos_vec[2] (Z) against active bounding box DAT_80128de8..DAT_80128df4.

name: p11_spr_reset_vram_anim_slots
summary: Zeroes the 0xb4-byte VRAM scroll/anim table and marks all 8 slot IDs starting at DAT_800a03b0 (stride 0x16) as unused (0xffff).

name: p11_spr_register_vram_anim_slot
summary: Avoids duplicate IDs in DAT_800a03b0 (8 slots stride 0x16), finds an unused (-1) slot, zeroes it via memset, and copies VRAM RECT/frame fields from slot_desc.

name: p11_spr_free_vram_anim_slot
summary: Checks DAT_800a03b0 for matching slot_id, clears its 0x16 bytes via memset, and resets its ID to 0xffff.

name: p11_spr_load_zone_tile_vram_overlays
summary: Iterates up to 8 VRAM/tile animation descriptors at script_ctx+0x8a8 (stride 0x12) when zone != 0xf or weather DAT_8007ad00 is storm/snow, dispatching active entries (!= -1) to FUN_800db140.

name: p11_spr_step_vram_moveimage_slot
summary: Uploads the current VRAM RECT via MoveImage unless suppressed by zone 0x5b without event flag 0x45, increments frame counter (+10), and loads the next frame descriptor from DAT_800a0378+0x8a8.

name: p11_spr_step_vram_scroll_slot
summary: Uploads split wrapped texture strips in VRAM via MoveImage for vertical water/waterfall scroll animation and advances offset (+10) by 2 pixels when timer (+0xc) reaches +8.

name: p11_spr_tick_world_prop_sprite_slots
summary: Loops over 8 world prop slots at DAT_800a03b0 (stride 0x16) when DAT_8006c844 pause bit 0x8000000 is clear, dispatching active slots (!= 0xffff) to FUN_800db4e0 or FUN_800db354 (if bit 0x8000 set).

name: p11_gfx_update_camera_offset_gte
summary: Rotates camera distance DAT_800a0384 by yaw DAT_800a0390 around DAT_800a4008 matrix via GTE PushMatrix/RotMatrix/RotTrans/PopMatrix into DAT_800a039c..a0.

name: p11_gfx_apply_camera_look_at_and_target
summary: Updates camera eye position (DAT_800a039c/9e/a0 + spawn DAT_800a03a4/a8) via FUN_8001b9f8 and camera target position DAT_800a03a4/a6/a8 via FUN_8001ba40.

name: p11_gfx_reset_camera_rig_params
summary: Sets default camera orbit distance (-0x2328), pitch/height (-0x1194), and yaw (-0x200) globals DAT_800a0384..DAT_800a0394.

name: p11_gfx_init_three_point_lighting
summary: Configures 3 PS1 SDK flat lights (DAT_80128db8/c8/d8) via GsSetFlatLight, sets ambient light (0x800, 0x800, 0x800) via GsSetAmbient, and enables light mode 0 via GsSetLightMode.

name: p11_gfx_step_particle_and_debris_pools
summary: Steps particle/effect update pools FUN_80038fe4(1000) and FUN_800379b4(1000) once per frame.

name: p11_gfx_draw_player_camera_rig
summary: Adds camera offsets DAT_800a039c/9e/a0 to spawn anchor DAT_800a03a4/a6/a8 into a local camera vector pair and draws DAT_80128818 via hm_gte_draw_animated_model.

name: p11_gfx_zero_camera_offsets_and_spawn
summary: Zeroes camera offset and target anchor globals DAT_800a039c..DAT_800a03a8.

name: p11_gfx_reset_hud_and_villager_timers
summary: Zeroes DAT_800742ac and resets 5 HUD prompt slots, clears DAT_8006c868, fills 0x80-byte + 8-byte timer blocks at DAT_8007aef7/aeff with 0xff, zeroes DAT_8007af7f, and sets default icon timers at DAT_8007ae79..aea4.

name: p11_gfx_is_hud_prompt_queued
summary: Scans the 5 HUD prompt slots starting at DAT_800742b0 (stride 0xc) for active entry matching prompt_id, returning 1 if found.

name: p11_gfx_show_hud_prompt_default
summary: Invokes FUN_800dbd78(prompt_id, 0, 0) to trigger a default HUD/screen prompt banner.

name: p11_gfx_show_hud_prompt_mode1
summary: Invokes FUN_800dbd78(prompt_id, 1, 0) to trigger a mode-1 HUD/screen prompt banner.

name: p11_gfx_show_hud_prompt_mode2
summary: Invokes FUN_800dbd78(prompt_id, 0, 1) to trigger a mode-2 HUD/screen prompt banner.

name: p11_gfx_tick_affection_and_weather_cutscene_timers
summary: Increments byte counters in DAT_8007ae78..8007aef8 capped at 0x78 when active, checks festival status via hm_ovl11_grid_tile_to_world, and steps cutscene triggers via hm_ovl11_trigger_cutscene_script while updating DAT_8007aef8 on storm/snow weather.

name: p11_gfx_alloc_hud_prompt_slot
summary: Optionally checks FUN_800dbb94, then scans 1 or 5 12-byte slots starting at DAT_800742b0 for a free (-1) entry, zeroes its fields, and returns its pointer.

name: p11_gfx_step_scene_animation_handler
summary: Invokes handler PTR_FUN_800b94ac[anim_index](), sets event flag 2 while running (!= 1), or clears flag 2, zeroes DAT_800742ac, and calls FUN_800dbe9c on completion.

name: p11_gfx_pop_hud_prompt_queue
summary: Shifts the 5-slot HUD prompt queue starting at DAT_800742b0 down by one 12-byte entry and marks tail slot DAT_800742e0 as 0xffff.

name: p11_gfx_finish_cutscene_actor_anim
summary: Checks whether DAT_8006c868+4 is non-zero; when true clears event flag 2 via hm_event_flag_set, zeroes DAT_800742ac, and invokes FUN_800dbe9c.

name: p11_gfx_has_queued_hud_prompts
summary: Checks HUD prompt queue slots 1..4 starting at DAT_800742bc and returns 1 if any slot != -1.

name: p11_gfx_clear_active_event_trigger
summary: Zeroes DAT_800a0380 active trigger pointer and resets DAT_800a0474 and DAT_800a0478 to 0xffff.

name: p11_gfx_reset_world_sprite_pool
summary: Calls FUN_8001e334(200) to reset world sprite rendering buffers.

name: p11_gfx_setup_map_lighting_and_weather
summary: Copies active map lighting parameters into 0x800a0368, triggers map palette/resource setup, updates time-of-day fog/tint, and dispatches extra tile handlers for field (0xf) or barn (0x2c) maps.

name: p11_field_complete_animal_feed_or_emote_action
summary: Clears active animal emote/status via FUN_800f3bcc(animal_rec+0xb6), plays SFX 0x13 and sets event flag 7 if animal_rec+0x30 == 0, clears +0xb6 and +0xdc, and returns 1.

name: p11_field_get_animal_waypoint_pos
summary: Looks up indoor/outdoor animal waypoint coordinates from UNK_80127d90..80127e40 by waypoint_kind (0..5) and barn/coop upgrade flags DAT_80070d08/0a, writing matching XYZ to out_pos.

name: p11_field_check_feed_trough_collision
summary: Offsets the animal's position by facing radius via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags, probes collision mask 0x8026 via FUN_800be26c, and if flag 0x20 hits inspects the tile via FUN_800d85f8.

name: p11_field_clear_animal_landing_tile
summary: Projects a 100-unit forward offset along animal heading animal_rec+0x22 via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags, converts to tile via hm_ovl11_interp_entity_heading or FUN_8011e090, and clears tile via FUN_800d8320.

name: p11_field_wait_animal_zone_dwell
summary: Tracks dwell ticks at animal_rec+0x2a while state +0x24 == target_state and returns 1 once min_ticks elapse and +0x30 or flags +0x7a & 0x300 are non-zero.

name: p11_field_is_animal_in_barn_zone
summary: Checks whether animal_rec is positioned inside barn/target zone 5 via FUN_80110494(animal_rec, 5, 0) and returns true if non-zero.

name: p11_field_step_animal_to_slot
summary: Sets animal target slot via FUN_800d1960, steps movement via FUN_8010e644, preserves bit 0x800 on animal_rec+0x34, and clears velocity via hm_ovl11_get_item_category_flags(4, animal_rec+0x48, 0) upon arrival when flag 0x2000 clears.

name: p11_field_get_animal_target_cell_center
summary: Resolves a pasture/barn/coop grid slot via FUN_80110658, converts its tile coordinates to world position via FUN_800d812c, and writes the coordinates via hm_ovl11_modify_gold_or_counters.

name: p11_field_find_random_matching_field_tile
summary: Starts at a random tile via hm_prng_next in DAT_80071dfc (45x25) or greenhouse DAT_80074124 (7x7) and scans wraparound using predicate FUN_80110790/FUN_80110838/FUN_80110890, returning tile coordinates on match (0) or 1 if none found.

name: p11_field_is_tile_active_crop_stage
summary: Checks tile via FUN_801108f8, excludes grass/special ranges (0x31..0x35, 0x178..0x179), and returns 1 when the tile growth byte matches its max stage descriptor in DAT_8006c858/DAT_8006c864.

name: p11_field_is_tile_tall_grass
summary: Checks tile via FUN_801108f8 and returns 1 if the secondary tile ID at tile_ptr+2 is 0x168 or 0x16a (cuttable grass/weed).

name: p11_field_is_tile_weed_or_grass
summary: Checks tile via FUN_801108f8 and returns 1 if the secondary tile ID at tile_ptr+2 is 0x168, 0x169, 0x16a, or 0x16b.

name: p11_field_is_tile_valid_non_grass_crop
summary: Verifies *tile_ptr is an active crop via hm_ovl11_is_entity_slot_active and returns true when *tile_ptr is not grass (0x36).

name: p11_field_pick_random_eligible_animal
summary: Scans chicken coop DAT_800742ec or barn livestock DAT_800749f4 (plus pregnant/special slots DAT_80076202/6206 and NPC actor jobs) matching target_zone and filter_flags (fed/produce/sick), returning a random index via hm_prng_next.

name: p11_field_get_barn_stall_pos
summary: Computes indoor barn stall XYZ coordinates from DAT_80127e60/64/68 for livestock slot_idx (0..0x15, including pregnant slots 0x14/0x15).

name: p11_field_get_coop_perch_pos
summary: Computes coop perch XYZ coordinates from DAT_80127ec0/c4/c8 at 400-unit X spacing for chicken slot_idx.

name: p11_field_clear_animal_bubble_state
summary: Resets animal emote bubble ID (+0xb6) and timer pointer (+0xdc) in animal_rec to zero.

name: p11_field_place_sprite_in_farm_work_zone
summary: Reads Harvest Sprite spawn XYZ and facing from DAT_80127ee0..ec using sprite ID sprite_actor+0xac, writes +0x38..+0x40 and +0x22, and sets zone +0x30 = 0x28.

name: p11_field_get_harvest_sprite_task_speed
summary: Computes Harvest Sprite task animation/move speed from season DAT_80070cf2/day, active chore (+0x26, +0xb8), skill levels (+0xae..+0xb2), and individual modifier DAT_80127f50.

name: p11_field_get_harvest_sprite_skill_delay
summary: Selects chore skill (+0xae, +0xb0, +0xb2) by Harvest Sprite task state (+0x26 == 8..10) and returns 2 * DAT_80076212[skill / 0x34] (or 0x18).

name: p11_field_reset_animal_bubble_when_idle
summary: Clears active animal speech/emote timer pointer at animal_rec+0xdc when bubble ID +0xb6 is 0 or when both +0xdc and animal_rec+0x30 are 0 (also zeroing +0xb6).

name: p11_field_dispatch_animal_feed_item
summary: Dispatches item_id in range 0x41..0x124 through jump table PTR_LAB_800bac24 to handle animal/NPC item gift response, returning -1 if out of range.

name: p11_field_map_treat_item_to_index
summary: Maps specific animal treat/feed/supply item IDs (0x68..0x124) to compact handler indices 0..15, or -1 if unmatched.

name: p11_field_init_sky_daylight_palette
summary: Resets DAT_8012d0e8 to 0, computes sunset hour via FUN_80111d28 and day phase via FUN_80111cc4, and submits initial sky palette gradient to DAT_8012d088/DAT_8012d0a8 via FUN_8001f664.

name: p11_field_update_sky_daylight_palette
summary: Queries sunset hour via FUN_80111d28(DAT_80070cf2) and day phase via FUN_80111cc4, driving sky tint interpolation in DAT_8012d088/DAT_8012d0a8/DAT_8012d0e8 via FUN_8001f664, FUN_8001f8a4, and FUN_8001fa0c.

name: p11_field_get_daylight_phase
summary: Classifies hour against dawn (5..6) and sunset_hour into daylight phase (0: dawn, 1: day, 2: dusk, 3: night).

name: p11_field_get_season_sunset_hour
summary: Returns sunset hour for the given season index from table DAT_80127f60.

name: p11_field_init_daylight_tint_default
summary: Resets DAT_8012d0ec to 0 and writes initial ambient RGB triple (0xcf7e, 0x105b, 0x166b) via FUN_800dcbdc(0, rgb).

name: p11_field_step_daylight_tint_fade
summary: While event flag 8 is 1, interpolates ambient RGB between DAT_80127f68 and DAT_80127f74 over 0x4b0 steps via hm_clut_lerp_rgb_triple, applies it via FUN_800dcbdc, and clears flag 8 when done.

name: p11_field_init_upgrade_and_memo_state
summary: Refreshes memo flags via FUN_80111ef0 and zeroes carpenter/upgrade timers DAT_80070d12, DAT_800719fe, and DAT_80070d10 during scene initialization.

name: p11_field_grant_cooking_or_tv_item_gift
summary: Classifies gifted item_id (0x13f..0x141 -> 4, 0xf7..0xf9 or 1..0x19 -> 2) into DAT_80070d12, stores item_id in DAT_800719fe, and sets event flag 0x37 via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_mark_tv_recipe_watched
summary: Sets TV/cooking state flag DAT_80070d10 to 3.

name: p11_field_sync_memo_hint_flags_wrapper
summary: Wrapper that delegates directly to FUN_80111f10 to recompute all memo and farm tip bitmask flags.

name: p11_field_refresh_all_memo_hint_flags
summary: Refreshes all 12 bitmask flags in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags_800719f8 covering tools, animals, crops, farm upgrades, sprites, and town NPC tips.

name: p11_field_tick_carpenter_upgrade_timer
summary: Decrements daily construction and countdown timers (0x80070d12, 0x80070d10, 0x800719fc) and completes Gotz farm building upgrades (coop, barn, house 1/2, greenhouse) when timers expire.

name: p11_field_consume_pending_unlock_notice
summary: Queries or consumes the pending farm upgrade/building completion code in DAT_800719fe (modes 0, 1, 2), applying coop/barn upgrades 0x13f..0x141 and refreshing memo flags.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit2_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 2 (0x4) in DAT_800719f8, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in DAT_80127f80 have affection > 100 via FUN_800f3e00, and sets bit 2 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit3_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 3 (0x8) in DAT_800719f8, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in DAT_80127f88 have affection > 100 via FUN_800f3e00, and sets bit 3 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit4_from_friends
summary: Clears bit 4 (0x10) in DAT_800719f8, checks whether all 4 NPC IDs in DAT_80127f90 have affection > 100 via FUN_800f3e00, and sets bit 4 if all qualify.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit0_from_npc5d
summary: Clears bit 0 (0x1) in DAT_800719f8 and sets it if NPC 0x5d has affection > 0x32 via FUN_800f3e00(0x5d).

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit1_from_npc5f
summary: Clears bit 1 (0x2) in DAT_800719f8 and sets it if NPC 0x5f has affection > 0x32 via FUN_800f3e00(0x5f).

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_5_to_7
summary: Updates recipe/memo hint bits 0x20, 0x40, and 0x80 in DAT_800719f8 from DAT_80070d30 bit 0x800, equipped tool DAT_80071a1e, and DAT_800719fc.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bit8_high_affection
summary: Clears bit 0x100 in DAT_800719f8, then sets it when DAT_80070d30 bit 0x200000 is clear and any NPC in DAT_80076220 (37 entries stride 0x1d4) has affection > 50000.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_9_to_13
summary: Sets milestone memo bits 0x200..0x2000 in DAT_800719f8 for the earliest missing upgrade among coop, house 1, barn, house 2, and greenhouse (DAT_80070d06..0c).

name: p11_field_update_goddess_memo_flag
summary: Clears bit 0x4000 of g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags_800719f8 and sets it when hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection(0x1e, 0, 2, 0) indicates the Harvest Goddess gift condition is unmet.

name: p11_field_refresh_recipe_bits_15_to_17
summary: Sets memo bits 0x8000, 0x10000, or 0x20000 in DAT_800719f8 based on coop/barn upgrades (DAT_80070d08/0a) and progress flags DAT_80070d30 (0x100, 0x200, 0x100000).

name: p11_field_update_town_npc_memo_flags
summary: Updates bits 0x40000, 0x80000, and 0x100000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags_800719f8 by querying hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection for NPCs 0x1c, 0x1a, and 0x1b.

name: p11_field_update_sprite_memo_flags
summary: Updates bits 0x200000 and 0x400000 in g_ui_unlocked_recipes_flags_800719f8 by querying hm_ovl11_query_npc_affection for NPCs 0x1f and 0x20.

name: p11_field_reset_family_milestone_state
summary: Clears DAT_8007afa4, sets DAT_8007afae to 0xffff, and sets event flag 0x1b via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_record_marriage_spouse
summary: Maps bachelorette spouse_npc_id (3, 7, 9, 0xe) to index 0..4 in DAT_8007afae, saves spouse ID in DAT_8007afb0, zeroes DAT_8007afa4, and latches wedding date into DAT_8007afcc..afd4.

name: p11_field_record_wedding_anniversary_date
summary: Saves current day DAT_80070cf4 and season DAT_80070cf2 into DAT_8007a416/DAT_8007a414, clears pregnancy flag 0x4e via hm_event_flag_set, and resets DAT_8007afa8 to 0.

name: p11_field_update_spouse_daily_chores
summary: When marriage event flag 0x41 is set via hm_event_flag_get, selects spouse actor DAT_80076220 + DAT_8007afb0*0x1d4, calls FUN_80112c28/ab4/c98, and if flag 0x4f is set updates baby via FUN_80112b60(&DAT_8007a3f0).

name: p11_field_get_spouse_profile_ptr
summary: Returns pointer from PTR_DAT_80127fd4 indexed by active spouse slot DAT_8007afae.

name: p11_field_advance_spouse_pregnancy_timer
summary: When baby born flag 0x4f is clear, advances days-married counter DAT_8007afac up to 0x1e, then sets pregnancy flag 0x4e once spouse affection (+4) >= 65000 and advances DAT_8007afa8.

name: p11_field_update_baby_growth_stage
summary: Increments baby age DAT_8007afa6 up to 300 and updates growth stage DAT_8007afb4 and event flags 0x50 (infant < 60), 0x51 (crawling < 120), and 0x52 (toddler).

name: p11_field_track_spouse_talk_neglect_days
summary: Increments DAT_8007afb2 when daily spouse talk flag 0x4b is 0 (resets to 0 if spoken), then clears daily spouse flags 0x4b and 0x4c via hm_event_flag_set.

name: p11_field_check_spouse_low_affection_sick
summary: If spouse affection (+4) drops below 0x3a99 and event flag 0x2b is clear, sets flags 0x4d and 0xaf via hm_event_flag_set and increments DAT_8007afaa up to 3.

name: p11_field_reset_all_mine_floors
summary: Clears all 10 floors (10x10 bytes each) of mine state in DAT_8012d126 and reset flags DAT_8012d11c.., then zeroes DAT_8012d510 and floor counter DAT_8012d110.

name: p11_field_check_player_on_mine_stairs
summary: Maps player coordinates to a 10x10 mine cell via FUN_801136d0 and calls FUN_80112ec4 to test for up-stairs on the previous floor or down-stairs on the current floor.

name: p11_field_trigger_mine_stairs_prompt
summary: Checks if the mine tile at (grid_x, grid_y) on floor_idx holds stairs (type 2), sets transition flags in 0x8012d510 and event flag 3, opens dialogue box, and ends player action lock.

name: p11_field_cache_mine_grid_pointers
summary: Scans the 10x10 mine floor grid (-0x708..+X, 0x708..-Z, step 400), caches tile pointers with flag bit 3 into 0x8009e5f8, sets mine base drop rate to 10, and clears bit 0x2000 of 0x8012d510.

name: p11_field_populate_mine_floor_tiles
summary: Iterates the 10x10 mine floor grid at DAT_8012d126 + DAT_8012d110*100 and spawns rocks/stumps (type 1) or ladder (type 2) at each cell via FUN_80113208.

name: p11_field_apply_mine_tile_decal
summary: Writes mine floor tile decal bytes/UVs from DAT_801281d0..DAT_801281d8[decal_kind*10] into map polygon descriptor referenced by DAT_8009e5f8 when walkable bit 8 is set.

name: p11_field_dig_mine_floor_tile
summary: Converts the hoe-target coordinate ahead of the player to a 10x10 mine tile via FUN_801136d0, reveals stairs down on RNG hit, or rolls an ore/item find via FUN_80113a20.

name: p11_field_world_pos_to_mine_tile
summary: Converts world XZ position to 10x10 mine grid indices (400-unit cells centered at -2000, +2000), returning 2/3 if out of bounds or bit 8 test on DAT_8009e5f8.

name: p11_field_tick_mine_stairs_confirm
summary: Ticks the active mine exit/descend confirmation prompt in 0x8012d510, warping to the waterfall/winter mine entrance on exit or incrementing mine floor DAT_8012d110 on descent.

name: p11_field_roll_mine_ore_or_powerberry
summary: Rolls hm_prng_next(100) against floor-weighted drop table UNK_80127fe8/DAT_80128088 for winter/normal mine DAT_8012d110 and gates one-time Power Berry (0x67) or Mystic/item (99) drops via flags 0x60..0x62.

name: p11_field_handle_mine_floor_entry
summary: Checks ladder arrival (DAT_80071afc high u16 == 0x42) or event flag 0x44, places player at ladder tile (DAT_8012d118, DAT_8012d11a), clears flag 0x44, and regenerates mine floor via FUN_80113c3c.

name: p11_field_set_mine_ladder_spawn_pos
summary: When mine depth DAT_8012d110 != 0, clears bit 0x1000 in DAT_800a00d4 and updates entrance spawn DAT_800a00e8..ec and ladder coords DAT_8012d114/16 from DAT_8012d118/1a.
